name: NVD
description: The U.S. National Vulnerability Database: what a CVE is and how severe, and which vulnerabilities CISA lists as known to be exploited. Works without a key at a low rate; an NVD API key (free) raises the limit -- set the auth to a header named apiKey.

operations.summary: One CVE: its description, severity score, and whether CISA lists it as exploited.
operations.ask_when: the question names a CVE id and asks what it is, how severe it is, or whether it is being exploited.

response.line: {id} ({vulnStatus}, published {published|date}): {descriptions[0].value|trunc:400} — CVSS {metrics.cvssMetricV31[0].cvssData.baseScore|default:n/a} {metrics.cvssMetricV31[0].cvssData.baseSeverity|default:} — CISA known exploited since {cisaExploitAdd|default:never}
response.empty: NVD has no record of that CVE.

operations.summary: Vulnerabilities in CISA's Known Exploited catalogue matching a product or vendor.
operations.ask_when: the question asks which vulnerabilities in a named product or vendor are known to be exploited, or on CISA's KEV list.

product.description: a product or vendor name, e.g. Fortinet

response.empty: No known-exploited vulnerability matches that product.

operations.summary: CVEs published in the last three days, optionally only those mentioning a product or keyword.
operations.ask_when: the question asks for recent, new or latest CVEs or vulnerabilities, optionally in a named product.

keyword.description: optional: a product, vendor or word to narrow to, e.g. Chrome

response.empty: No CVE was published in the last three days that matches.
